title: Permission Requirements
content: Joinly now requires you to have the MANAGE_SERVER / MANAGE_GUILD permission in your server to use setup commands.
This change was made because you're managing your server's settings with Joinly, and it makes permissions more consistent across all setup commands.

title: Website Upgrade
content: We are now using Netlify instead of GitHub Pages to provide improved performance, better uptime, and extended deployment capabilities.
This change allows Joinly to benefit from more advanced features, improved reliability, and a smoother experience for everyone.
